introHtml: Port Authority beanies offer a consistent fit and soft acrylic construction that holds up to repeated wear and washing. For corporate winter giveaways or employee appreciation kits, these beanies provide a professional look without the high cost. Choose from multiple colors and add your logo via embroidery for a clean, durable finish that stands out in cold weather.
